name: CustomTaskPane
description: Represents a custom task pane in the container application.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: Gets a String representing the title of a CustomTaskPane object. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets the Application object of the host application. Read-only.

properties.name: Window
properties.description: Gets the parent window object of the CustomTaskPane object. Read-only.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: True if the specified CustomTaskPane object is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: ContentControl
properties.description: Gets the Microsoft ActiveX control instance displayed in the custom task pane frame. Read-only.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Gets or sets the height of the CustomTaskPane object (in points). Read/write.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Gets or sets the width of the task pane specified by the CustomTaskPane object. Read/write.

properties.name: DockPosition
properties.description: Gets or sets an enumerated value specifying the docked position of a CustomTaskPane object. Read/write.

properties.name: DockPositionRestrict
properties.description: Gets or sets an enumerated value specifying a restriction on the orientation of a CustomTaskPane object. Read/write.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the active custom task pane.

events.name: VisibleStateChange
events.description: Occurs when the user changes the visibility of the custom task pane.

events.name: DockPositionStateChange
events.description: Occurs when the user changes the docking position of the active custom task pane.
